<includeonly>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Item|cargoObtainedFromStore|stablekey={{{stablekey|}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{#cargo_declare:_table=ObtainedFrom
|ItemKey=String
|SourceType=String
|SourceKey=String
|SourceText=String
|Probability=Float
|IsGuaranteed=Boolean
|Quantity=Integer
|SourceCondition=String
|Origin=String
}}
Hidden store owner of the unified item-obtainability junction (one row per item × source × condition when a source has variants), transcluded by the item page.

<code>ItemKey</code> is the obtained item's StableKey. <code>SourceType</code> is one of <code>drop</code>, <code>vendor</code>, <code>dialog</code>, <code>quest</code>, <code>craft</code>, <code>item_use</code>, <code>mining</code>, <code>fishing</code>, <code>item_bag</code>, <code>starting</code>, or <code>community</code>. <code>SourceKey</code> resolves by type to a character, quest, item, zone, or class StableKey; it is null for free-text community rows. <code>SourceText</code> carries free-text community sources. <code>Origin</code> is <code>generated</code> or <code>community</code>.

<code>SourceCondition</code> is deliberately used instead of <code>Condition</code>, because <code>CONDITION</code> is a SQL keyword and would silently disable the declaration in the Cargo fork. Generated rows leave <code>SourceText</code> and <code>Origin</code> null until the Phase 4 community layer adds its rows.
<code>SourceCondition</code> is part of the generated-row identity so fishing day/night rows remain distinct.
</noinclude>
